decision: Require map-grounded bilingual scenarios, full transcripts, retrieval traces, and reverse-target ranking checks
why: The evaluation must test real behavior against falsifiable conditions, not model self-report
evidence: user authorization in current turn; backend/tests/run_openrouter_bilingual_eval.py
result: definition of done set

decision: Sequence grounded design, deterministic scoring, two-case pilot, blinded Luna runs, reverse-target retrieval, Qwen review, and final rerun
why: Each phase ends in direct evidence and the pilot catches broken measurement before the full live spend
evidence: current-turn commentary; OpenRouter model pages; Google Routes API docs
result: seven gates defined

why: Google route products are unavailable to the configured key, while Kakao exposes current Seoul route facts.
evidence: Live probes: Google Routes HTTP 403; legacy Directions REQUEST_DENIED for billing; Kakao public transit returned 15 routes for a Gangnam path with distance/time/transfers/fare.
result: Transport assertions will use Kakao; app distance assertions will compare API output against independently computed Haversine distance.

why: A live-key run must not leak the Google key, and retrieval must never look complete after an exhausted planner loop.
evidence: Three focused tests failed before the fix: key present in captured log; missing retrieval metadata; no result after repeated no-tool responses. The same three tests now pass.
result: Sanitized Google transport logging; explicit retrieval status, termination, coverage flags, scope count, and deterministic no-result safeguard.

why: The Sol casebook fits the current runner and can produce live bilingual evidence now; the patient-room/signed-ledger design is stronger but disproportionately broad.
evidence: Cross-judge scored Sol 5/5 for smallest rerunnable change and recommended grafting blind projection, deterministic gates, explicit retrieval completion, and independent distance checks.
result: Use Sol scenarios and Likert policy; save scrubbed full transcripts plus a separate metrics report; defer socket proxy, HMAC receipts, and hash-chained event storage.

why: The live run must prove the actual deployed model and complete indexes before sending any patient request.
evidence: Fresh Docker image 2e9f34fa40a1; /health returned openrouter, chat=openai/gpt-oss-120b, agent=openai/gpt-oss-120b, facilities=8484, vectors=8484, raw_reviews=1791749.
result: Live gate passed on isolated http://127.0.0.1:17860; retrieval debug stack is enabled only in this container.

why: The first blinded pair is evidence and must remain unchanged even though it failed.
evidence: Both full owner-only journeys were saved; deterministic hard gates failed intent/refinement, geography/distance, orchestration, and reverse-target retrieval; English also ended at the iteration limit.
result: Baseline retained under backend/tests/evaluation_runs; every extraction had JSONDecodeError or TypeError and fell back to a citywide 25 km state.

why: The failure combined intermittent empty/truncated GPT OSS output with an address-only Kakao fallback that could not resolve stations.
evidence: 56 backend regressions pass; live Kakao keyword lookup resolves Daeheung Station and 대흥역 to 37.5476479056751,126.942473188734; image sha256:3ed3c0249bea700398d6652dd45d5d44a2fdbd71c593ef6f004570b356f1431b is healthy.
result: Disabled nested SDK retries, bounded calls to 60 seconds, added validated one-retry structured/text boundaries, and added Seoul-only Kakao landmark lookup; fresh blinded pair launched.

why: The repaired first turn proved geography, but the follow-up must not be treated as success when the client could not complete it.
evidence: English turn one independently matched the station and all five results were within 2 km; retrieval ended incomplete at ten iterations, the second refinement widened to 5 km and completed server-side after about 156 seconds, and the blocked event loop prevented Korean startup.
result: Preserved the one-turn 0600 journey and failing metrics; no Korean conversation artifact was fabricated.

why: The system must quantify what multilingual review evidence is actually available without pretending script detection is perfect language identification.
evidence: Of 1,791,749 nonempty raw comments: 1,735,083 Hangul/no Latin; 5,125 Latin-only English-like; 20,427 mixed Hangul+Latin; 31,114 other. Target 19521641 has 565 raw comments and all three sealed evidence IDs resolve.
result: Report these as script buckets; raw multilingual retrieval is mandatory because the decisive cheilitis/explanation/fast-treatment evidence is absent from the target facility summary.

why: GPT OSS repeatedly searched without assessing coverage and narrowed raw review lookup to three facilities, making the hidden relevant facility unreachable.
evidence: 62 regressions pass, including forced stage order and a model-supplied subset that can no longer shrink the 10,000-facility backend scope.
result: Force semantic+facility BM25, exact indexed evidence, full-scope multilingual comments, evidence selection, assessment, then finish; allow further bilingual refinement only after an insufficient assessment; run blocking chat work in FastAPI's threadpool.

why: Separate patient commands posted the app root, returned HTTP 405, and later parallel commands could overwrite an earlier turn.
evidence: The route-normalization regression failed before the fix and passes after it; a new single-process runner proves turn two receives turn one's state; transport failures are now saved owner-only.
result: Accept root or /chat endpoints, serialize every visit in one process, and retain failed attempts instead of fabricating or dropping conversation history.

why: The first complete two-turn bilingual pair is evidence even though retrieval remained incomplete.
evidence: Both owner-only artifacts have two HTTP 200 turns and retain 2.0 km; SHA-256 English 6d44dbcd1669e9dcfd52f62fa3c9eb3d588f28b83fd48d3edb0122037f63201b, Korean 2d5cf6eb625143c6c3f4002c89d04a7efbb1386ee9dd1fdcf7d5b8fa998e9fab; target appeared only at ranks 16-20 and neither final top five contained it.
result: Preserve the pair as a failing pre-fix run; do not relabel it as final success.

why: GPT OSS sometimes emitted several tools in one assistant response, so selection and assessment ran before the model could read raw comments; its Korean refinement also replaced 피부과 with generic 병원.
evidence: Failing regressions reproduced the premature extra tool, generic-specialty clobbering, missing Korean aliases, and contradictory coverage claim; all focused regressions pass after fixes.
result: Execute exactly one tool per iteration, preserve specific specialty/radius on refinement, expand cheilitis/explanation/fast-treatment terms deterministically in both languages, and require an empty missing-constraints list for completion.

why: The execution safety layer rejected recreating a container that loads credentials and raw reviews because selected review excerpts could reach OpenRouter.
evidence: Container relaunch request was rejected after the final retrieval build; no workaround was attempted.
result: Finish offline verification and require explicit renewed user confirmation before the final live GPT OSS/Qwen run.

why: The original grader could pass an incomplete or wrong-language staged journey and did not bind target evidence or transit truth strongly enough.
evidence: Sol's red run exposed 4 failures and 5 errors; the final 17 focused checks cover finished/two-turn/2xx/language/run-ID integrity, ordered successful retrieval, same-facility verbatim decisive evidence, explicit ranks, reciprocal pair identity, and bound Kakao observations.
result: Adopt casebook schema v3 and keep contextual evidence omissions visible without making every contextual review an arbitrary hard gate.

why: The preserved two-turn pair is useful diagnostic evidence but does not satisfy the canonical staged card or retrieval target.
evidence: Strengthened reports fail both languages: no finish_search, incomplete iteration-limit termination, target absent from presented top five, decisive evidence missing; pair top-five Jaccard 0.0. Transit binding passes; health, turn integrity, and language gates pass.
result: Retain reports as pre-tool-serialization metrics and do not publish a passing claim.

why: All locally provable behavior must pass after the last fixes even while the credentialed rerun is blocked.
evidence: git diff --check and py_compile pass; 77 unittest cases pass; Docker build succeeds as non-root user on port 7860 with healthcheck; manifest digest sha256:cac9bd1a668147f32ea3ae79970c8c7eb22566ac75eef59108a6ae2eec34ced2.
result: Final image is ready for a credentialed rerun once renewed transmission approval is provided.

why: The published corpus split must be reproducible and must recognize decomposed and compatibility Hangul, not only precomposed syllables.
evidence: backend/tests/profile_review_languages.py and the production RawReviewStore share all Unicode Hangul ranges; a full local scan reports 1,805,211 total rows, 1,791,749 nonempty, 1,735,083 Hangul/no Latin, 5,125 Latin-only English-like, 20,427 Hangul+Latin, and 31,114 other; focused contracts pass.
result: Document these as mutually exclusive script groups, not verified language labels, and keep the command in README.

why: A seeded target must be discoverable from the complete eligible review scope before relying on model orchestration.
evidence: backend/tests/probe_reverse_target.py searched 54 dermatology facilities within 2 km of Daeheung Station using 20 Korean and English terms; target 19521641 was 0.982709 km away and ranked first, with decisive evidence review:325180cb5153b903bfa2 matching 구순염, 자세한 설명, and 빠른 진료; owner-only report 20260902-mapoderm-offline-probe.json passes.
result: The deterministic review layer can retrieve the target; the remaining live gate is whether GPT OSS 120B orchestrates the full loop and presents it in both languages.

why: The earlier preflight row overstated isolation because normal API responses still serialized internal retrieval traces and planner arguments.
evidence: Normal mode now allowlists patient facility data and review provenance while removing internal scores, candidate stacks, matched terms, traces, tool arguments, and server run metadata; debug mode retains them for the isolated evaluation container; /set_travel_preference clears injected telemetry too; four focused checks pass.
result: Treat the older wording as superseded; rebuild and rerun the full suite before release.

why: The final source, browser bundle, and container must all be checked after the privacy and Unicode changes.
evidence: 88 backend tests, full backend/tests py_compile, git diff --check, and the Next.js production build pass. Docker image sha256:11d7096c094a4248ce98b9f572ac949ed73b0b96493f4b29581043606f16aeb6 runs as user, becomes healthy with the documented secret names, serves / as HTTP 200, and reports OpenRouter GPT OSS 120B with 8,484 facilities, 8,484 vector documents, and 1,791,749 raw reviews.
result: Offline Hugging Face artifact is ready; the canonical credentialed bilingual conversations and Qwen ratings remain deliberately unrun pending renewed external-processing confirmation.

why: Temporary verification containers must not retain credentials in inspectable Docker configuration after use.
evidence: Sol found seouldoc-hf-verify with live environment values; exact temporary containers seouldoc-hf-verify and seouldoc-hf-final were force-removed, and docker ps now shows no SeoulDoc containers. The final image config and filesystem scan contain no .env, run artifacts, or live-key-shaped values.
result: Rotate every credential named in backend/.env before another live run: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Groq, Google Maps, Kakao, Hugging Face, and Naver client credentials. Never launch future verification containers with the whole env file; pass only required secrets and remove the container after the run.

why: A local secret file must not be readable by group or other users.
evidence: backend/.env permissions were 0664; changed to 0600 and verified with stat without reading or changing any value.
result: Keep real secrets only in this ignored owner-only file and Hugging Face Secrets.

why: Location, medical search terms, and travel preferences must not appear in routine logs without analytics consent.
evidence: Location provider helpers gate raw diagnostics on consent and sanitize provider failures; state-merge logs now record value-free operations; three focused privacy regressions pass.
result: Raw patient location and medical preferences are absent from no-consent diagnostics while consented location diagnostics remain available.

why: The release image must be reproducible, non-root, free of credentials and local evaluation tooling, and verifiable without real secrets or outbound traffic.
evidence: 94 backend tests, py_compile, git diff --check, and Next.js production build pass; no-network dummy-key smoke reports 8,484 facilities, 8,484 vectors, and 1,791,749 raw reviews; content scan passes; release tag points to sha256:40ee96a97dea257859b789dc0e61461c85bc28b7945119dd9b0b4f464d43e51f as user.
result: Offline Hugging Face artifact is ready; credential rotation, renewed external-processing authorization, and the canonical live GPT OSS/Qwen bilingual pair remain required for a validated release.

why: The credentialed GPT OSS 120B pair must be preserved exactly, including failures, so model and retrieval regressions remain diagnosable.
evidence: English and Korean journeys completed in two HTTP turns with healthy app/index gates and owner-only artifacts. English deterministic hard pass was false: iteration_limit, strict-radius leakage, missing negative constraint, target absent. Korean deterministic hard pass was false: agent_error, mixed first response, strict-radius leakage, missing multilingual comment stage, target absent. Pair top-five Jaccard was 0.0.
result: Do not publish this pair as a passing release; use it to drive the next retrieval/orchestration fixes.

why: The qualitative grader must use the requested Qwen3.8 27B model and bounded evidence projection.
evidence: OpenRouter catalog confirms qwen/qwen3.8-27b; low-reasoning 4,096-token request returned valid JSON. English weighted mean 1.9/5, minimum 1, failed. Korean weighted mean 1.6/5, minimum 1, failed. Both owner-only rating artifacts record model qwen/qwen3.8-27b.
result: The grader is operational; the live app remains below the configured pass policy and must be fixed before shipping.
